Pink and blue are two minds. The yellow lens is where they meet: the spark of recognition.
It reads as a flower (care, growth) and as a brain (memory) at once, so the app looks warm and not clinical.
Two mirrored sets of four circles: three lobes and a core.
Lobe radius 34, core radius 46, centers 48 apart.
Clear space: one lobe radius on every side.
